ownerInstruction: From now and until the end of time I won't care about debug timings, we dont even have to run those in debug.
scope: Standing policy with no release/version expiry: Debug performance timings are not release gates; timing-only Debug qualification courses may be omitted. Mixed courses retain functional coverage, timing misses remain recorded when observed and need no repeated waiver request. Preserve bounded execution/hang detection and functional failure handling. Optimized Release timings, compilation and artifact/source/security/signature/trust remain required.
supersedes: Per-release Debug timing-budget acceptance requirements; historical failures retain their actual results.
